correctness.rationale: The secondary-polytope theorem for convex polygons gives a simple polytope of dimension n−3 with facets indexed by diagonals; collections of facets meet exactly for pairwise noncrossing sets because these extend to a triangulation. The sum and first moment of GKZ coordinates are independent of triangulation by area and triangle centroids. Their three linearly independent constraints cut out an affine translate of W_n, so the dimension theorem gives equality. Rotation permutes coordinates and fixes the vertex average in the relative interior. Translating to that origin, taking the Euclidean polar in W_n, and projecting radially gives actual equivariant homeomorphisms from the diagonal complex to the representation sphere. The discarded real Fourier modes are the constant and the two first modes. The frequency representatives are 2 through floor(n/2), with a real sign line at n/2 when n is even. At a prime all surviving weights give no eigenvalue one for any nonidentity rotation; for composite n, a divisor weight d with 2≤d≤n/2 is fixed by r^(n/d). At p≥7 the sphere is simply connected and its complex rotations preserve orientation. The lens-space cellular homology gives exactly the stated odd-degree torsion and top integral class. The classifying map to BC_p is an isomorphism in integral cohomology below sphere dimension p−4 (the first nonzero positive fibre row has degree p−4). Pulling back the cyclic degree-two class gives nonzero powers through 2k≤p−5; any generator is a unit multiple. The p=5 circle exception and the generator change (2,3)→(1,5) mod 7 are correct. The independent check `python3 /workspace/review_calculations/small_cases.py polygon` checks every orbit of a diagonal under each nonidentity rotation for the specified small n. An invariant nonempty face must contain at least one noncrossing orbit, so this checks all geometric stabilizer types there, not merely fixed maximal triangulations. It does not prove the homeomorphism or the topology by enumeration.

evidence: The existing lens homeomorphism implies the stated finite range of powers by the sphere fibration over BC_p. Cyclic sieving shows no fixed face for d=p and 1≤k≤p−3. For even composite n a diameter is fixed by the half-turn (k=1,d=2); for odd composite n a proper prime divisor d≥3 gives a fixed d-diagonal dissection (the central regular d-gon), included in the nonzero k=d case of (7.2).
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A fixed face fixes its barycenter and every fixed geometric point has invariant support. Thus even the extra composite direction follows from published all-face-size coverage. The powers are automatic from the exact known quotient; neither addition is a new theorem of the frozen scope.
